column3: “Was called on their name” is rendered “was named after them.”
“Their document, those enrolled” is rendered “their ancestral registration,” and “were defiled from the priesthood” as “were considered unclean and excluded from the priesthood.”
“The holy thing of the holy things” is rendered “the most holy things.”
Most Hebrew manuscripts lack this verse; NASB includes it, as in Ezra 2:66.
MT 7:69. “Some of the end of” is rendered “some from among.”
